name: @pg-prime/bench-runtime
description: Runtime perf gates (design/09 WS7): compile time and allocations, the closure-tree decoder against a hand-written positional mapper, and design/08 §5's nine raw-vs-orm pairs. Builds packages/pg-prime with the workspace root toolchain (typescript59 alias 5.9.3) and imports the emitted JavaScript; `pg` is the raw side of the end-to-end pairs.
